title: Fruitbae Salt E-Liquid – Grapefruit Watermelon 30ml
description:
Description
Zesty meets sweet with this one! Say hello to an exotic twist between sweet and zesty grapefruit and thirst quenching, fresh watermelon. You guys are in for a treat with this one! Tangy and sweet with a hint of mint. Take your taste buds out on a fruity adventure!
Finished with a cool exhale.
Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Sorbae Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
60% VG 40% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Sorbae is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
